title: Bass, mutes and violin in dance bands
summary: Bass players picked or bowed; Sam Morgan's brother was a fine violinist; Pope played trumpet under a violinist leader before forming his own band.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: The old bass players, when they played the string bass, did they use a bow or did they pick?

Very southern, they used to pick. They used to pick here most of them. That's right. Very southern they used the bow. I think the best violin player we had come through here was Sam Morgan's brother. I guess you remember those mugs. Yes, I know. Well, he used to use the bow. I think he was the only one that played by music, I think. And he took that up away from me.
Yes. Did you used to use mutes?
One other question is, did they ever use a violin in the dance bands?
In the orchestra? Yes, that's right. Sure. He played violin. Someone else I can't remember right now, back in those days. I suppose the violin player
was the leader. Was he the leader of the orchestra? Well, he was leader of his own.

That's one I have reference to. When I left him, I organized my own orchestra and I was leader of that band. Quite a long time. And you had a violin in that band too? He played with me at times. Actually played violin in his own band. I played with him. I was trumpet playing in his band.
